preconditions: plan evidence, mapped-contact intersections, and edited orientation template are hash-bound
each evaluated contact has an explicit SyntheticAssumption or EvidenceCandidate orientation
decisionLogic: derive the local section azimuth from the exact route segment containing each mapped intersection
project true dip to apparent dip and propagate the declared angular uncertainty
clip nominal candidate lines exactly against the piecewise-linear DEM profile
audit every explicitly declared contact/contact order over its complete shared support
assemble only explicitly declared terrain/contact or proven contact/contact units
permit zero thickness only where a terrain/contact unit closes at an outcrop endpoint
render no inferred or undeclared lithology polygons
uncertainty: one symmetric angular bound is conservatively applied to dip and dip direction
exclusions: not an inference from aerial imagery or terrain
validationMethod: positive input, fail-closed empty input, and hash-binding rejection tests
reopenCondition: direct structural observations, authenticated review, or unit-topology declarations become available
